title.value: Run grocery, email and photo tasks through Comet browser

introduction.value: A reviewer gave Comet access to his Intermarché account and tried it on email cleanup, sorting 8,000 Dropbox photos and calendar planning, with failures and security risks.

method.value: Julien Rio paid $20 a month for Comet Pro and gave its assistant logged-in access to Intermarché, his 15-year-old inbox, YouTube Studio, Dropbox and Google Calendar. He asked it to analyse purchases, clean email, sort 8,000 photos into daily folders, and turn a vacation spreadsheet into events. He restarted it repeatedly.

outcome.value: Mostly failed. It couldn't read Intermarché's PDF receipts and found only a handful of emails. Only 300–500 of the 8,000 photos moved in days, and the calendar took 40+ restarts. He uninstalled it.

notes.value: The invoice-filing task moved his whole inbox into a oddly named folder; he recovered it, so back up or test on a small sample first.

source_text.body:
Run grocery, email and photo tasks through Comet browser
A reviewer gave Comet access to his Intermarché account and tried it on email cleanup, sorting 8,000 Dropbox photos and calendar planning, with failures and security risks.
Done with
PC
Perplexity Comet
What they did
Julien Rio paid $20 a month for Comet Pro and gave its assistant logged-in access to Intermarché, his 15-year-old inbox, YouTube Studio, Dropbox and Google Calendar. He asked it to analyse purchases, clean email, sort 8,000 photos into daily folders, and turn a vacation spreadsheet into events. He restarted it repeatedly.
How it went
Mostly failed. It couldn't read Intermarché's PDF receipts and found only a handful of emails. Only 300–500 of the 8,000 photos moved in days, and the calendar took 40+ restarts. He uninstalled it.
Worth knowing
The invoice-filing task moved his whole inbox into a oddly named folder; he recovered it, so back up or test on a small sample first.
Try it yourself
with
Perplexity Comet
Copy prompt
I'm logged into [grocery store or service]. Please [specific task, e.g. build a basket for these items: list], and show me the final basket with prices. Do not check out, pay, delete or send anything without pausing and showing me exactly what you are about to do first.
Original source: https://www.julienrio.com/marketing/english/tested-comet-perplexity-AI-powered-browser.html
